description: Discern what to do with anything WITHOUT doing it — the proposal half of the engine, laid open. Bring a claim, a question, or a messy statement; get back what KIND it is, the necessary claim reduced to only what could change a verdict (private and framing context held back, not sent), the structured (domain, spec) the gate would verify, and where it routes. It PROPOSES, never confirms — no verdict, no seal: hand the returned `claims` to `verify` to dispose. Crisis is discerned first and routed to real people, never the gate. The twin of the verify door; nothing is generated.

text.description: anything — a claim, a question, or what is on your mind

name: discern
